_comment: Cross-language parity fixture for git remote URL SHAPE validation (v0.2.91 #30, M5). Consumed by BOTH launcher/src/lib/components/subagent-git-repo-logic.test.ts (isValidGitRemoteUrl — the UI mirror driving the Connect button) AND the Rust unit test url_validation_parity_table in launcher/src-tauri/src/commands/worktree_repo_mode.rs (is_valid_git_remote_url — the authoritative backend gate). Rows are [url, valid] tuples. Edit HERE only; both suites iterate this table and assert cases.length == case_count (silent-truncation guard) — bump case_count in the same edit that adds/removes rows. Leading-dash rows (M8) pin the argument-injection guard: a '-...' candidate would reach git as an OPTION, so both validators must reject it before any git process runs.
